RAJYA SABHA
Thursday, the 1st February, 2018/12th Magha, 1939 (Saka)
The House met at thirty minutes past one of the clock,
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair.
THE UNION BUDGET, 2018-19
MR. CHAIRMAN: The Union Budget, 2018-19; the Finance Minister.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE; AND THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE 
AFFAIRS (SHRI ARUN JAITLEY): Sir, I rise to lay on the Table, a statement (in English 
and Hindi) of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the Government for the year 
2018-19.                [Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 8677/16/18]
FISCAL POLICY STATEMENTS, 2018-19
MR. CHAIRMAN: Fiscal Policy Statements, 2018-19; the Finance Minister.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE; AND THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE 
AFFAIRS (SHRI ARUN JAITLEY): Sir, I rise to lay on the Table, under sub-section (1) 
of Section 3 of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003, a copy each 
(in English and Hindi) of the following papers:—
(i)  Macro-Economic Framework Statement;
(ii)  Medium-term Fiscal Policy Statement; and
(iii) Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement.
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 8678/16/18]
MR. CHAIRMAN: The House stands adjourned till 11.00 hours on Friday, the 2nd 
of February, 2018, that is, tomorrow.
The House then adjourned at thirty-one minutes past 
one of the clock till eleven of the clock on 
Friday, the 2nd February, 2018.
